page_description_chirho: Sign in with the account details issued to you for the private Perffection beta.
heading_chirho: Sign in with the details we gave you.
intro_chirho: Your account is already set up. Use your sign-in name and password to open your private workspace.
principal_help_chirho: Use the complete sign-in name we gave you, including user/ at the beginning. It is not your email address.
credential_help_chirho: Use your current password. Your draft stays private until you choose to publish a saved version.
help_body_chirho: Lost your sign-in details? Contact the person who gave you access. Ask for help with your existing account so your saved work stays with you. Never send anyone your password.
retry_body_chirho: Check the complete sign-in name and use your current password, including any change you made. If you have tried several times, wait before trying again. You do not need a new account.
setup_body_chirho: If you were given a setup code, use it to choose your own password first. Then sign in here.
no_session_body_chirho: Sign in to continue securely. If you changed your password, use the new one.
exhausted_body_chirho: You were signed out of this session after too many incorrect password-change attempts. This attempt did not change your password. Sign in with your current password to continue.
invalid_credential_body_chirho: Check your sign-in name and password, then try again. If you changed your password, use the new one.
rate_limited_body_chirho: Please wait about {wait_minutes_chirho} minutes, then try again. If you still need a hand, open Help with signing in. Never send anyone your password.
password_set_body_chirho: Sign in with your sign-in name and your new password.
account_closed_body_chirho: You are signed out. Thank you for the time you spent building with us.
